items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 71:1
items.html: The Sefira of Netzah is the ZA of the body, because the five discernments KHB ZON are called in the body HGT NH. See above, answers 38 and 39. (Part 1, Page 888, Sub Header, "and he raised").
